statement: The client has an aggressive risk profile with a 20-year horizon, an objective of aggressive growth, and a high capacity to bear losses. The proposed portfolio consists of iShares S&P 500 Information Technology Sector UCITS ETF USD Acc (SRI 5) and CoinShares Physical Bitcoin ETP (SRI 6). The suitability check confirms that this portfolio is suitable for the client's risk class 5 profile. The average SRI of 5.5 and individual fund SRIs align well with the client's aggressive growth objective and loss tolerance. The client does not have any short-term liquidity needs within the next two years. Draft for advisor review and signature.
